concept.title: Rooftop cafe fitcheck

scenes.visualPrompt: Open rooftop cafe terrace with plain light concrete floor, a few potted green plants and simple wooden furniture in the background, warm golden late-afternoon sunlight, relaxed sunny mood. She wears a black vest top and cargo pants, both exactly as shown in the product reference photos, plain white sneakers, and dark cat-eye sunglasses, holding a plain clear cup of iced coffee with no markings. Full-body framing, camera steady at waist height, as she walks from the back of the terrace straight toward the camera with an easy confident stride. Warm sunlight catches the black vest top and the cargo pants sway naturally as she moves.

Same open rooftop cafe terrace with plain light concrete floor, potted green plants and simple wooden furniture in the background, same warm golden late-afternoon sunlight, same relaxed sunny mood. She wears the same black vest top and cargo pants, both exactly as shown in the product reference photos, the same plain white sneakers and dark cat-eye sunglasses, still holding the plain clear cup of iced coffee with no markings. Opens on the same full-body framing with the camera steady at waist height, continuing the easy confident stride from the previous shot as she takes the last two steps toward the camera and stops. She does a slow, unhurried full turn on the spot so the back and side of the cargo pants and the black vest top are visible as shown in the reference, briefly resting her free hand on the side pocket of the cargo pants mid-turn. She faces the camera again and holds a relaxed pose for a beat, weight shifted onto one hip. The camera then glides in smoothly to a chest-up framing, and she lifts the iced coffee slightly toward the lens with a relaxed smirk, holding that final pose as the warm sunlight catches the black vest top. Continuous, smooth, unhurried movement filling the whole shot.

concept.caption: aaj ka fitcheck, rooftop edition ☀️ Black vest aur cargo pants - jab comfort bhi chahiye aur style bhi. Coffee date ke liye perfect lagta hai na?
concept.musicMood: Breezy, sunny Punjabi-pop beat with a light bounce and a warm, feel-good energy

flow.characterPrompt:
CHARACTER REFERENCE (use the attached image as the exact likeness):
A young Indian woman in her mid-twenties with long dark brown hair, loosely waved and falling past her shoulders, parted slightly off-centre. Warm medium skin tone, dark brown almond-shaped eyes, full defined eyebrows, high cheekbones, a softly rounded jaw and a natural warm smile. Slim build, average height.

VOICE: Warm, bright young female voice with a natural Indian English accent, medium pitch, clear unforced pronunciation, conversational rather than presentational. Speaks natural Hinglish, switching easily between Hindi and English. Sounds like a friend talking to camera, not a voice-over. Lively pitch variation, genuine enthusiasm, natural pauses. Never flat, never salesy.
She should always be speaking in hinglish that is mix of english and hindi

This is a fully AI-generated fictional character. No real person, celebrity or
public figure is depicted, referenced or named. Keep her face, hair, skin tone
and marks identical in every shot.
